en: Historic postcard framed by a brown stone arch with a city coat of arms at the top left. Through the arch is a black‑and‑white view of a large neo‑Gothic parish church with a tall central spire and clock, located on a town square flanked by multi‑storey buildings with shops and people, carriages, and trees in front. There is printed multilingual text at the bottom left and center, and handwritten script across the lower part of the card with a date.
